profile.headline: Fullstack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with more than 12 years of experience as fullstack engineer, with solid expertise in Typescript, Angular, Javascript (ES 6) and React. Also, with experience in: PHP, Java JEE, and Test Automation (Selenium, Jmeter).

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.insights: Skills: C# · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Data Pipelines · Architecture

positions.title: External Information Technology Consultant
positions.description: his company has a diverse range of projects, that requires a broad knowledge of: database management (MySQL), DevOps tools (GitLab CI, Jenkins), infrastructure (Linux servers, Dockers), logging and monitoring tools (Kibana, Elasticsearch), and development (PHP, Typescript, Angular). I helped to the development of a mobile application that supported the sales process of the vendors, from one of the customers of the company. Using Ionic as Mobile Framework, I helped to build providing them with online stocking from the app, making product orders offline (and solving conflicts once the orders were synchronized with the server), and making monitoring the visits that they did to the customers via Geolocalization.
positions.insights: Skills: Model-View-Controller (MVC) · Kibana · PHP · Mobile Consulting · Elasticsearch · MySQL · Symfony Framework · Angular

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: This company has the main goal of transitioning to a SaaS company, so when I started working here it was required to create a flexible architecture that helped to support new features, and at the same time, including those new features in the current legacy code. As a contribution to that goal, I helped in creating a widget infrastructure based on Web Standards (HTML5, Web Components) that allows using new technologies in web development (angular 8,9,10) and, at the same time, support legacy frontend infrastructure (based on Knockout.js). Also, I created new features using angular 8 (and using the widget infrastructure mentioned previously). In parallel , I upgraded existing unit testing infrastructure to one based on Karma/Jasmine, and also, supporting on the migration from a tsbuild based process to a webpack build based process.

positions.title: Ingeniero de Proyectos (Project Engineer)
positions.description: The University had the main goal of upgrading an old Mobile Application to a new version that could support the diverse range of services that the students had access (library, digital ID, campus digital map, car locator, among others). I lead the project, applying Ionic as Mobile Framework, and working in Java-based microservices. The new application allowed the students to access a diverse range of services (achieved through integrations to existing systems in the backend side) and also, offering some interactivity via IoT devices. Also, I helped to boost the process of agile adoption inside the IT Department, helping with training to the employees, and giving advice to other project teams

positions.title: Development Coordinator
positions.description:
FUNCTIONS: 
-	Analysis, design and deployment of Software (programming language: PHP, Javascript, Java) process automation oriented.
-	Management and analysis of MySQL Relational Database Engine.
-	Linux Servers Management.
-	Technical consultant at Technological Projects.
ACHIEVEMENTS: 
-	Corporative Intranet Deployment (using Joomla).
-	Joomla Component Development, using jQuery and PHP.
-	Java (J2SE) development of an ETL to extract and transform data from plain files (separated with positions), to load on a database (Engine: MySQL).
-	Development of a software for extract information from a Web Application to load on a database, using Java and Selenium WebDriver.
-	Development of a Web reporting software using PHP, MySQL, Javascript, and using these libraries / frameworks: Codeigniter, JQuery, JavaBridge, Jasper Reports and Twitter Bootstrap on the Frontend.
-	Development of a software for massive reporting generation and email sending, using Java, SQLite and Selenium WebDriver.
-	Participation on the initial iteration of BPM and Enterprise Architecture definition of the business.
